## 1. Known-channel block operation and ordinary method

For any strictly positive m-by-n K and known rational k-by-n L with distinct
columns, a finite iid block can simulate K exactly without raw X. Let C_r be
the confusion matrix of nearest-column classification of the empirical proxy
distribution, with deterministic ties. Put kappa=min K_yx and
Delta=min_{x!=x'}||L_x-L_x'||_infinity>0. If each classification error is <=d,
then ||C_r-I||_1<=eta=2d. For eta<1,

    ||C_r^-1-I||_1 <= eta/(1-eta).

Since ||K||_1=1, V=K C_r^-1 is nonnegative if eta/(1-eta)<kappa. Its columns
sum to one, and V C_r=K. Coordinate-wise Hoeffding plus a union bound gives
d<=2k exp(-r Delta^2/2); for example

    r >= (2/Delta^2) log(8k(1+kappa)/kappa)

suffices with slack. The executable `compile_by_classifier` instead accepts
the actual exact rational identity and positivity certificate. It enumerates
M=binomial(r+k-1,k-1) types, using O(Mnk) rational operations plus inversion
and O(Mk+n^2) words. Encodings grow with r and input bit length. Delta may be
exponentially small, and M is not polynomial uniformly in k. This is ordinary
classification and garbling, not a new complexity result. A joint-channel LP
may improve its repetition count with the identical supplied observations.

The exact source pair is

    L=[[2/3,1/6,1/6],[1/6,2/3,1/6],[1/6,1/6,2/3]],
    K=[[2/15,49/120,49/120],
       [13/30,71/240,71/240],
       [13/30,71/240,71/240]].

The retained one-record primal/dual gives q*=3/40; `verify.py` independently
checks feasibility and equal objectives. The unique ordinary one-record
postprocessor has first row (-1/20,1/2,1/2), excluding zero raw cost there.

With two records let c count those equal to zero. Choose output zero with
probabilities (13/25,17/100,0) at c=0,1,2; otherwise split outputs 1,2 equally.
Its output-zero law at p=L_0x is

    g(p)=13/25-(7/10)p+(9/50)p^2.

Direct substitution gives g(2/3)=2/15 and g(1/6)=49/120. Thus the entire K
channel is exact at all inputs with two cheap calls and no raw call. The
ordinary classifier construction independently yields

    C_2=[[8/9,11/36,11/36],[1/12,2/3,1/4],[1/36,1/36,4/9]],
    K C_2^-1=[[17/210,58/105,58/105],
               [193/420,47/210,47/210],
               [193/420,47/210,47/210]],

which is stochastic with the same acquisition counts. There is no special

## Exact two-call specialization

For the acquired source K,L,let c be the number of zeros in two actual iid
records. A no-read output-zero probability w_c=(13/25,17/100,0) gives

 sum_{z1,z2} L_{z1,x}L_{z2,x} w_c
   =13/25-(7/10)p_x+(9/50)p_x^2,
 p_x=L_{0,x}.

At p0=2/3 this is2/15;at p1=p2=1/6 it is49/120. Splitting the remaining mass
equally produces the complete K column. The U table is stochastic,so this is
an exact zero-raw feasible certificate for the product-record LP. It does not
contradict the prior one-L-record optimum3/40:the acquired record and cheap-call
budget changed. Ordinary classifier/confusion inversion in the supplied extension
also achieves two cheap calls with no raw,so no special advantage is established.

## Actual runtime review and verification

Root preserved the worker's frozen files and created `runtime/` as the reviewed
copy. One callback-boundary correction converts equality indicators to Python
integers before adding them: numpy integer callbacks otherwise produce numpy
booleans whose addition can lose the count of two zero records. All nine such
callback words now give the exact intended weights. No mathematical rule changed.

All three supplied verifiers were rerun in this root-owned runtime and passed.
Their output JSONs remain here, with roughly .013s,.058s,.191s recorded core
verification times. Root also independently reconstructed the source channel
identities and the102-call bound in `independent_checks.py`. Finite diagnostics
support implementation scope; the reviewed arguments establish the general
claims under ideal iid/unbiased-bit promises. Seeded PRNG samples do not certify
ideal randomness or a physical proxy service.

Reviewed code hashes are in `RUNTIME_REVIEW_RECEIPT.json`; factory.py and
factory_lazy.py match the worker core exactly, and operation.py has only the
typed-callback correction. Historical priority, real proxy acquisition,
complete-resource advantage and civilisation-level capability remain UNKNOWN
or NOT_ACHIEVED. Established garbling, Bernstein factories, concentration and
common-part coupling receive the same observations and costs.
